description:
Surface precipitation drop size distribution collected aboard Aurora Australis, summer 2017-18.  Text files containing drop size distribution information collected by an Eigenbrodt disdrometer ODM470 aboard Aurora Australis during summer 2017-18. Data are raw and require post-processing to extract rain rates

Files are of different types:

*rd* files:  Contain the raindrops (precipitation) data. Example dataset line-by-line:
18102017 223341 3.90 01.37 0018 015 0012 009
The above line consists of:
Date as DDMMYYYY format; time as HHMMSS; instrumental reference voltage; wind speed (m/s); number of snow particles; number of occupied bins (classes)  “snow”; number of snow particles; number of occupied bins (classes)  “snow”

CS 013 017 018 022 027 028 029 031 033 034 035 037 080 116 119 
The above line consists of:
Class Snow; then three digit blocks indicating which classes have observed drops (e.g. classes 13, 17,… in the line above)

DS 002 001 002 001 001 001 002 001 001 001 001 001 001 001 001 
The above line consists of:
Number of drops per class in snow algorithm (e.g. 2 in class 13; 1 in class 17; 2 in class 18 etc)

TS 000516 000933 000340 000271 000149 000115 000415 000286 000113 000093 000541 000160 001913 001476 001922 
The above line is not used (legacy)

CR 013 018 022 027 028 029 033 034 037 
The above line indicates the number of drops per class in the rain algorithm (13, 18, 22 etc)

DR 002 002 001 001 001 002 001 001 001 
The above line indicates the occupied rain classes (2 in class 13, 2 in class 18, 1 in class 22 etc)

TR 000516 000340 000271 000149 000115 000415 000113 000093 000160
The above line is not used (legacy)

*drops* files: internal raw data and are produced by the disdrometer but not needed by the user.
title: Surface precipitation drop size distribution collected aboard Aurora Australis, summer 2017-18
